content.text: Mortgage brokers is one person you might run into when buying a home. In this video, Kate Wood addresses mortgage brokers, a person you could interact with during the home buying process. She breaks down what they do (and don't do) along with information to consider should you want to work with a mortgage broker when buying a home.
